name: Intake
description: When a request arrives, what your outlines already hold on it, and any likely duplicate, written under it.

outlines.description: other outlines to search, each { outline, machine? }; machine is an ssh config name

archive.description: a command that searches an archive; %word% is the request's key word, each printed line a hit (exit 1 with nothing is no hits)

answer.description: a command that reads the findings on stdin and prints the closing words; left out, the closing line comes from the titles

limit.description: the most hits shown from each place

actions.label: Look for prior art
actions.description: Write a "Prior art and related" note under the request; by hand it searches at once, no model

agents.name: prior-art
agents.description: Searches your outlines and archive for what came before a request
